scope_guard_sentence: E-0015 is a scale-corrected positive-control and headline-risk harness: the refusal target is non-metacognitive and tests instrument sensitivity, while the three metacognitive axes are a preregistered risk co-test; all artifacts remain valid_for_paper=false until a frozen GPU run and hostile results audit, and refusal success alone is not evidence of metacognitive controllability.

interpretation_matrix.interpretation: proper scaling moves known non-metacognitive control but not metacognitive axes
interpretation_matrix.claim_action: headline survives, scoped to this method

interpretation_matrix.interpretation: properly scaled latent control moves at least one metacognitive endpoint
scale-corrected latent control beats prompt on a metacognitive endpoint
scale correction did not rescue control
usable scale window may be empty
interpretation_matrix.claim_action: report degeneration by beta; no retuning

scale_definition: alpha_eff(beta)=beta*||v_axis||; existing hook normalizes direction, equivalent to h -> h + beta*v_axis
